name: Kaserna - Borgmästarbruket
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage from Kaserna to Borgmästarbruket, following Munkedalsälven and Örekilsälven on forest paths, gravel roads and asphalt; no public ferry or official alternate geometry found; official and partner text contain stale Harska naming, but title, WST API, GPX, OSM and adjacent-stage continuity support Borgmästarbruket as the Stage 16 endpoint

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 16. Kaserna - Borgmästarbruket
keyFacts: Official WST title is Kaserna - Borgmästarbruket.
Official slug is 16-kaserna-borgmastarbruket.
Official direction is Kaserna to Borgmästarbruket.
Official distance is 6 km / 6000 m.
Official estimated time is 2-3 h.
Official difficulty is blue / medium.
Route is in Munkedal municipality.
WST describes water, rapids, pebble beaches and a mix of forest path, dirt road and asphalt.
WST says the route starts by the canoe center at Kaserna with parking, information board, outdoor toilet and water when the canoe center is staffed.
WST says Smedsbergskrysset reaches the end and Stenbron is along the trail.
WST gives a walking connector from Munkedal station via Örekilsparken, the suspension bridge/walkway, road 924, Stale and the Hedekas road.
caveats: WST body text also says the section goes between Kaserna and Harska and starts next to the canoe center in Harska; treat that as stale/mislabelled because title, GPX, API, municipality, OSM and continuity support Borgmästarbruket.
WST Kaserna bridge status lacks a year in the rendered/API text and must be live-checked before publication.

keyFacts: GPX metadata time is 2021-10-25T08:56:06.100Z.

caveats: Point density is uneven with long spans up to about 195 m, so classify the official geometry as planning-grade or near-navigation-grade rather than high-resolution navigation-grade.
